evidence_quotes.O: The SpaceNavigator supports several products that I use on a daily basis: Graphisoft ArchiCAD, Abvent Artlantis Studio, Google SketchUp and Google Earth.
evidence_quotes.C: I tested this 4.5 foot cable on four configurations involving PC, Mac, USB 2.0 and USB 1.1
evidence_quotes.E: My (horse) riding-instructor wife purchased this Ion portable PA system about two months ago to use while teaching clinics.
evidence_quotes.A: I did not remove any stars from my review for this reason: I just wanted to make clear up front that this is currently a Windows-only product.
evidence_quotes.N: I feel ripped off for the price that I had paid for this case, as it began falling apart after 2 weeks.
